
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/davablog/p/20118305" title="发布于 2026-06-11 13:42">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于SQL实现分组的文字排序聚合</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>作为数据工程师，对数据进行处理分析时，时常遇到基于SQL实现分组内的文字列的排序聚合是非常常见的场景，比如按照价格高低进行各类别下商品的汇总、按照成绩进行各班的学生的排名等。当下，支持SQL的数据库生态百花齐放，SQL方言也是多种多样，为了方便记忆，以下总结了常见的几类数据产品或者平台的支持情况（代码经过实际测试可跑通）：</p>
<p>假设数据集为sales，需要展示每个类别下的按照价格排序的商品清单。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE TABLE sales AS<br>SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Electronics</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> category, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Laptop</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> product, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1000</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> price <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UNION</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">ALL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Electronics</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Mouse</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UNION</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">ALL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Electronics</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Keyboard</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">80</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UNION</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">ALL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Furniture</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Desk</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">300</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UNION</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">ALL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Furniture</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Chair</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">150<br>；</span></pre>
</div>
<p>1，Spark</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    concat_ws(</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
        TRANSFORM(
            SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(price, product))),
            s </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.product
        )
    ) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> category
;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>2，Impala</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    regexp_replace(
        group_concat(concat_ws(</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">|</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, rn, product), <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[0-9]+\\|</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
        category,
        product,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">cast</span>(row_number() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">OVER</span> (PARTITION <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> STRING) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rn
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales
) t
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category;</pre>
</div>
<p>3，Oracle</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> category
, LISTAGG(product, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) WITHIN <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> product_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales t
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">group</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">by</span> category</pre>
</div>
<p>4，SQL Server</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    STRING_AGG(product, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) WITHIN <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category;</pre>
</div>
<p>5，PostgreSQL</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    string_agg(product, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category;</pre>
</div>
<p>6，MySQL</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    GROUP_CONCAT(product </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price SEPARATOR <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category;</pre>
</div>
<p>7、SQLite&amp;DuckDB</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    string_agg(product, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted,
    group_concat(product, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> price <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DESC</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sales
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category;</pre>
</div>
<p>8，ClickHouse</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">方式一，利用子查询先行排序</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    arrayStringConcat(groupArray(product), </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> category, product
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> db_test.sales
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category, price <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ASC</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> category;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">方式二，Lambda表达式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    category,
    arrayStringConcat(
        arrayMap(
            x </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-&gt;</span> x.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">2</span>,   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 提取元组的第二个元素，即 product</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            arraySort(
                x </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-&gt;</span> x.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>,   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 按元组的第一个元素（price）升序排序</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                groupArray((price, product))
            )
        ),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> products_sorted
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> db_test.sales
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GROUP</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> category;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>总结：</p>
<ul>
<li>大数据体系：
<ul>
<li>Spark SQL：需要使用collect_list + sort_array + transform + concat_ws 组合才能实现该功能。</li>
<li>Impala SQL：不支持 order by 在 group_concat 内，需要在子查询中利用row_number先行排序 ，代码相对复杂，且该方法只支持Impala 2.3+。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>商业产品：
<ul>
<li>Oracle：listagg(expr, sep) within group (order by …)</li>
<li>SQL Server：string_agg(expr, sep) within group (order by …)，只支持2017+。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>开源产品：
<ul>
<li>PostgreSQL：string_agg(expr, sep order by …)</li>
<li>MySQL：group_concat(expr order by … separator sep)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>嵌入式数据库：
<ul>
<li>SQLite&amp;DuckDB：group_concat(expr, sep order by ...), 或者string_agg(expr, sep order by ...)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>分析型数据库：
<ul>
<li>ClickHouse：较旧的版本中需要使用子查询或者arrayStringConcat + groupArray + arraySort + arrayMap，从24.8版本开始支持groupConcat(sep)(expr ORDER BY ...)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>国产信创数据库：
<ul>
<li>达梦DaMeng：可设置兼容模式，一般设置为兼容Oracle，可支持listagg语法</li>
<li>海量Vastbase：原生兼容PostgreSQL，支持string_agg</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Oracle listagg是商业数据库比较早的实现该功能的函数，使用方便，最为经典并广为人知。SQL Server前期支持较弱，后期弥补了该功能短板，为了方便用户记忆使用，格式与Oracle格式高度相似。开源数据库中，Mysql和PostgreSQL各自使用了独立的格式，相对商业数据库，变化较大，需要额外的记忆。嵌入式数据库中，无论是OLTP的SQLite，还是OLAP的DuckDB，其格式与PG高度一致，说明PG的影响力非常大，SQLite从3.44.0版本开始支持带order by功能，DuckDB本身定位为分析型数据库，从最早的版本即有完整的功能支持。大数据体系的特点是海量存储和非结构化数据处理，针对结构化数据的复杂处理逻辑，支持相对较弱，可以看出Impala和Spark的SQL实现逻辑最为复杂，嵌套使用了多种函数，代码冗长，很难快速记住。分析型数据库中，ClickHouse早期的逻辑比较复杂，Lambda函数类似Spark SQL，后期应该是为了用户使用方便，做了简化，但语法保持了自己的特色。国产信创数据库方面，目前多为兼容Oracle或者PostgreSQL，暂时应该还未发展出独立的语法体系。</p>
<p>以上只记录了语法格式的差异，而由于各个产品的架构设计不一样，实际使用中性能的差异可能会比较大。当然如果数据量不大，没有到亿级的规模，性能应该都是可以接受的。</p>
<p>进入大模型时代之后，靠记忆来记住不同数据库的语法既耗时也没有必要。只要稍微描述下场景，大模型直接可以写出完整的语句。只要掌握各类数据产品的特点和背景，数据工程师在面对新数据产品的时候，就可以快速利用AI大模型进行各类复杂逻辑的SQL开发。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
